title: The Decision Receipt Law
principle: Homework is mandatory before deciding — and the report is 'I chose X, I looked at A, B, C, X won because,' with the scorecard as receipt.

source.context: Refinement of the Wisest Choice Law: autonomy is never blind.

evidence.note: 'A decision without homework is guessing, not autonomy.'

applicability.decisions: What analysis precedes a decision; how to report it.
